11/12/2007:  Station Maintenance (sm): 
 
             - Battery Replaced. 
 
                   - Battery was running low and eventually died.   Was 
                     replaced today.   MAWN program was also reset to  
                     power-on modem and collect data on a 3-hour cycle 
                     in order to help conserve power. 
 
 
 
 
05/22/2007:  Station Maintenance (sm): 
 
             - Communication converted to broadband cell-modem: 
                   - Broadband cell-ip modem installed 
                   - Datalogger progam "mawn_aacs" loaded and compiled. 
                   - Battery voltage now reported every hour. 
                   - Data collection configured to upload every 30 minutes. 
 
             - General station maintenance and system checks. 
                   - Work was done approx: 15:00 - 15:30 (Day=142)

04/08/2002:  Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
 
             - Daylight Savings Time Started on Day=97, Time=200. 
 
             - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (forward)  
               from Day=97, Time=200 through Day=97, Time=410. 
 
 
 
 
10/30/2001:  Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
 
             - Daylight Savings Time Ended on Day=301, Time=200. 
 
             - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (subtracted) 
               from Day=301, Time=200 through Day=301, Time=610. 
 
 
 
10/30/2000:  Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
                 
             - Daylight Savings Time Ended on Day=303, Time=200. 
 
             - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (subtracted) 
               from Day=303, Time=200 through Day=304, Time=1405. 
               Only Observation Times were modified, not times of 
               Maxs and Mins.  Users will need to take that into 
               consideration when using this data. 
 
 
 
04/15/2000:  Old Mission station added to MAWN database 
 
 
 
04/14/2000:  Phone Line To Station Activated. 
 
 
 
04/14/2000:  Data Logging Activated (mawn1b) 
            
             - Data Logger Start Time:  00:05, Day=105
